title: Photographs of Ed Lansdale in Dealey Plaza identified by his wife

tellings.quote: Photographs of Lansdale sitting right there and his wife identifying it.

plain: There are said to be photographs of a man named Ed Lansdale in Dealey Plaza in Dallas on the day President Kennedy was shot in 1963, and his wife is said to have identified him in them. A researcher named Dan Sheehan says this on a show about Kennedy and UFOs, without naming his source: "Photographs of Lansdale sitting right there and his wife identifying it." If true, it would put Lansdale at the scene of the killing.
